headerDisplay: Shows ecobee Smart Security as a security system in Apple Home (arm Stay / Away, disarm, alarm state). Unofficial: uses the same ecobee cloud as the app.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name shown in the Home app.

refreshToken.title: Refresh token
refreshToken.description: Filled in when you sign in above. Only needed again if ecobee signs the plugin out (password change, 'sign out everywhere').

homeId.title: Home ID
homeId.description: Only needed if the account has more than one home; the log lists them.

pollInterval.title: Check every (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to read the armed state, so changes made in the ecobee app or at the keypad show up in Apple Home.

offerNight.title: Offer Night
offerNight.description: Adds Night to the Home app, for automations or Siri that use it. ecobee has no Night mode, so Night arms Stay; the Home app keeps showing Night until the state changes. Changing this setting recreates the security system in the Home app, so scenes and automations that use it have to be set up again.

alarmTrigger.title: Enter Triggered State
alarmTrigger.description: ecobee opens an incident as soon as a door or sensor trips while armed. "After the Entry/Disarm delay" waits until that delay runs out without a disarm, so automations on Triggered don't fire while you're walking in to disarm. Smoke alarms always trigger immediately.

smokeSensor.title: Smoke sensor
smokeSensor.description: Adds a Smoke Sensor to the Home app that detects smoke whenever ecobee reports a smoke-alarm incident, so you can use it in automations and get Home app smoke notifications.

airQuality.title: Air quality sensors
airQuality.description: For ecobee thermostats with an air quality sensor (ecobee Premium): adds an Air Quality Sensor (overall level and VOC) and a Carbon Dioxide Sensor (CO2 in ppm) per thermostat. ecobee's own HomeKit integration doesn't show these. Updated every 5 minutes.

co2Alert.title: CO2 alert level (ppm)
co2Alert.description: The Carbon Dioxide Sensor reports abnormal CO2 at or above this level, for Home app notifications and automations (for example, turning on ventilation).
